HFT visibility is governed by the authoring policy above.","docket_mode":"quarantine_without_hft","docket_ready":true}},"selected_context_units":[],"support_registry":[{"branch_refs":["root_000526/B002","root_001372/B004"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-2","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_248f696bd71278b36be3","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:14:1\",\"root_000526\",[\"B002\"]],[\"32:14:4\",\"root_001372\",[\"B004\"]],[\"32:14:9\",\"root_000526\",[\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Gelecekteki yüz yüze karşılaşmayı önemsememek, gün hazır olduğunda onu kaçınılmaz ve doğrudan yaşanan bir bilgiye dönüştürür.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_001372/B004"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_5a7d4705c4b4d94375ba","text":"2. **A refused encounter becomes unavoidable experience.** `ل ق ي:B004` is face-to-face encounter, while the repeated imperative uses `ذ و ق:B002`, undergoing or directly experiencing punishment, beyond ordinary tasting in `ذ و ق:B001`. “This day” deictically collapses the distance that allowed the meeting to be neglected. **Inferred arrow:** refusal to orient toward a future encounter -> compelled experiential knowledge when it becomes present. Taste is the mechanism by which an abstractly neglected meeting becomes immediate and undeniable.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001501/B001","root_001501/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-1","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_6cacdf5590d0c56bfdc4","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:14:3\",\"root_001501\",[\"B001\",\"B002\"]],[\"32:14:8\",\"root_001501\",[\"B001\",\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Aynı unutma kökünün iki özneyle yinelenmesi, ilahî unutmayı hafıza kusuru değil, onların karşılaşmayı sürekli ihmaline karşılık gelen ölçülü bir terk ediş yapar.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_7a58c7026f532862ff7a","text":"Later 32:17 and 32:19 repeated the work-to-recompense construction on the opposite side of the outcome. That symmetry showed that reciprocal neglect in 32:14 is not an isolated punitive wordplay; it is one instance of a broader rule in which sustained action returns as a matching experienced state.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000429/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_7fdeaac0e3fe13801cb1","text":"3. **Repeated tasting opens into duration rather than a momentary sample.** `خ ل د:B001` supplies enduring permanence, and the command *dhūqū* occurs twice around the reciprocal-neglect clause. The final *bimā kuntum taʿmalūn* gives sustained prior action as cause. **Inferred arrow:** repeated action -> direct requital -> an enduring state. The second command prevents “taste” from shrinking the punishment to a brief contact; it is entry into the lasting consequence named by *al-khuld*.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001501/B001","root_001501/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_8feafd234290d023c6bb","text":"1. **The repeated root turns neglect into reciprocal abandonment.** In the first *nasītum*, `ن س ي:B001` permits forgetting and `ن س ي:B002` permits abandoning or neglecting; in the divine reply, `ن س ي:B002` specifically supports leaving as recompense rather than a lapse of memory. Reversed subjects and the causal *bimā* make the relation explicit. **Inferred arrow:** their sustained neglect of the encounter -> corresponding abandonment to its consequence. The repetition changes “we have forgotten you” from defective recall into measured reciprocity.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000526/B001","root_000994/B001","root_000994/B003","root_000994/B005"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-4","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_a734b602c6e5cb387a81","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:14:1\",\"root_000526\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:14:9\",\"root_000526\",[\"B001\"]],[\"32:14:10\",\"root_000994\",[\"B001\",\"B003\",\"B005\"]]],\"grade\":\"reject\",\"text\":\"Tatma alanındaki tatlı su ve yoksun bırakma çağrışımları, azabı iyi ve besleyici olandan mahrum bırakılan olumsuz bir ağırlanma biçimi gibi düşündürebilir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_001372/B004"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_ab1c4787b662851ba42c","text":"2. **A missed encounter becomes an enduring condition.** **ل ق ي B004** supplies face-to-face encounter, **ي و م B003** an event-day, **ع ذ ب B005** punishment, and **خ ل د B001** enduring permanence. The first taste concerns neglect of a meeting; the second names the lasting state produced by habitual action. I infer that refusing temporal encounter hardens into continuous consequence. The \"day\" is therefore not just a date forgotten but an appointment whose neglected relation becomes durable.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000429/B001","root_000526/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-3","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_b3ecb60042aca1457b05","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"32:14:1\",\"root_000526\",[\"B002\"]],[\"32:14:9\",\"root_000526\",[\"B002\"]],[\"32:14:11\",\"root_000429\",[\"B001\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"İki kez tadın denmesi ve sonsuzluğun adlandırılması, tadı kısa bir temas olmaktan çıkarıp sürekli eylemin kalıcı sonucuna giriş yapar.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000994/B005"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_c02fe8210ab43f41232d","text":"3. **Punishment as deprivation of palatable provision (exploratory).** Beside punishment in **ع ذ ب B005**, **ع ذ ب B001-B003** supplies sweet water, abstention, and withholding; ذوق makes this taste-field unusually audible. Later, believers receive prepared guest-provision (32:19), whereas fire-dwellers repeatedly taste punishment (32:20). I infer a negative-provision mechanism: what they taste is the withholding of the good sustenance available in the alternative abode. This reading coexists with direct torment rather than replacing it.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_efa5fb474d631f9afa0b","text":"The prepared **نُزُلًا** of 32:19 and repeated tasting in 32:20 sharpened the contrast between hospitality and punitive experience. The water and food chain in 32:27 made the dormant sweet-water and abstention branches of **ع ذ ب** materially vivid.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000526/B002","root_001501/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_f382ed0f65763acd2d06","text":"1. **Reciprocal abandonment, not symmetrical amnesia.** **ن س ي B002** supplies leaving or abandoning a covenant or command and divine leaving as recompense; **ذ و ق B002** supplies undergoing an experience.
